_source: Consolidated from One Page Resume Creation Tool Kit C7 (SOPs + Resume Creation Checklist) and Sample Master CV Template guideline sheets. 'check' = how OnePager enforces it: 'render' (template guarantees it), 'auto' (validator checks it), 'ai' (generation prompt enforces it, validator flags), 'user' (student must confirm).

presentation.rule: Use font size 9 throughout the CV
All headings and sub-headings must be bold
Email ID and LinkedIn (full URL) must be clickable blue hyperlinks; add portfolio link (full URL, hyperlinked) if applicable
Headings on the left, left-aligned; dates and locations in the right column, left-aligned
Name in CAPS, bold, black. Educational institutions and company names all in the same CAPS format
Underline sub-skill headings inside experience/internships; italicise company descriptions/roles in brackets on one line next to the main header
Bullet points should ideally fill one full line (no spill-over to a second line, no half-empty lines)
Italics for Professional Summary and company descriptions
Use bar marks ( | ) as separators, not full stops
Whole resume must fit on exactly one A4 page

header.rule: Name, phone number, email ID and LinkedIn profile (full URL); portfolio full URL if any
At the top of the resume, centred

professional_summary.rule: Do not start with 'I'; start with an action verb; focus on measurable achievements and outcomes
Highlight spikes: leadership, awards, entrepreneurship, sports or expertise
Create a clear professional identity aligned to the target domain

education.rule: Institution names in CAPS, spelled exactly as the institution writes its name
Programme written in full form (e.g. 'MBA in Finance'), not as a bare abbreviation
Degree, institution and graduation year clearly stated
Bar marks instead of full stops; write CBSE Class X & XII in Roman numerals

experience.rule: Bullets follow Result-Action-Context (RAC): lead with the result, then the action, then the context
Include measurable outcomes and impact (numbers, %, ₹, scale)
Remove experiences irrelevant to the target domain
Bullets easy to understand and outcome-oriented
Date range in month'yy format, e.g. Apr'24-Jul'24
Group bullets under underlined bold-italic sub-skill headings (e.g. 'Growth Marketing & Revenue Impact') when a role has 4+ bullets

projects.rule: Focus on research, live projects, freelance work or college contributions

extracurricular_leadership_awards_certif.rule: Mention positions of responsibility and ownership
Include measurable achievements: footfall, revenue, sponsorship, participants, timeframe
Add competition scale or ranking context (e.g. 1st of 150, national level)

skills.rule: Only relevant business and technical skills
Every skill must be backed by experience/projects in the resume
Align skills with the target role/domain keyword list
Group skills logically into buckets (Business Skills | Technical Skills)

master_cv_guidelines.academic_achievements: Cover: position out of total (top 10%ile, 10/350), year, quantified scholarship/prize money/funds. Types: scholarships (purpose, amount, out of how many, awarded by, when), institute/department rank & medals, olympiads (conducted by, subject, state/national/international rank, year), competitive exams (CAT/GMAT/GRE/JEE/XAT score, admits, year), professional courses (CFA, CS, Six Sigma, NCFM), job/PPO offers, recommendations, academic projects (papers, dissertations, academic internships), online courses (score, sponsorship).
master_cv_guidelines.certifications: Full name, issuing organisation, year; level/tier (e.g. CFA Level 1, Six Sigma Green Belt); score/percentile/distinction; selection criteria or rank; sponsorship; projects done, tools learned, real-world application.
master_cv_guidelines.work_experience: Position | Company | Tenure. Achievements covering: impact & business results; core responsibilities & skill development; innovation & process enhancements; stakeholder management & collaboration; professional recognition & endorsements. Record everything: trainings, ideas proposed, projects, tools, people mentored.
master_cv_guidelines.internships: Position | Company | Tenure. Recognition & key takeaways; key contributions & learnings; process improvements/new ideas; client/team exposure; LOR/LOA from seniors.
master_cv_guidelines.b_plan: B-plan competition position/award and outcome; venture idea, seed funding, outcome; national-level case competitions.
master_cv_guidelines.positions_of_responsibility: Heads: student council, cultural/tech/management fest, NGO, clubs/committees (literary, theatre, E-cell, NEN, sports), team/house captain, class rep, workplace leadership (thread lead, CSR). Roles: treasurer, chairperson, counsellor, editor, core member, secretary, president, VP, coordinator, head, volunteer. Quantify footfall, revenue, sponsorship (partner + amount), timeframe; events initiated; workshops; corporate talks; NGO outcome.
master_cv_guidelines.extra_curricular: Categories: social contribution (volunteering, crowdfunding, NGO); sports (rank, out of how many, state/national/international level, sport); public speaking (rank, participants, level, debate/JAM/extempore); creative writing/art (rank or publication, submissions, activity); cultural (rank, level, activity); miscellaneous (biking, martial arts, painting, yoga, trekking, travel, quiz).
